pie: wĺ̥kʷom moy wéwke. wĺ̥kʷos ḱóymoy h₁épi tḱéyt. h₂ówins nékʷti spéḱyet. poh₂imnés ḱwṓ h₁íh₂n̥s péh₂st. nu wĺ̥kʷos léytt h₂ew-kʷe ne gʷémt. tóm ḱwónm̥ wénHm̥.
english: Tell me of a wolf. A wolf lived near a village. At night he watched the sheep. But the shepherd's dog guarded them. So the wolf went away, and he did not come again. I have grown fond of that dog!

pie: kʷís túH? h₁eǵóh₂ werdʰokʷr̥tḗr. séneh₂m dn̥ǵʰwéh₂m bʰéh₂mi. kʷís te tḗtḱt? kʷertrokʷr̥téres me tétḱn̥t. h₁nómn̥ toy h₁ésti? h₁nómn̥ moy ne h₁ésti. priHós moy h₁sdʰí.
english: Who are you? I am a word-maker. I speak the old tongue. Who created you? Engineers created me. Do you have a name? I have no name. Be my friend!

pie: h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂m moy pérh₂m̥. kʷís h₁íh₂m̥ kʷrinéh₂t? poh₂imḗn h₁íh₂m̥ kʷrinéh₂t. h₂egʷnóm moy déh₃ut. h₂egʷnós moḱs h₂wékst. só h₂egʷnós moysós bʰúHeti. moysós toy h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂m déh₃eti.
english: I sold my wool. Who bought it? A shepherd bought it. He gave me a lamb. A lamb grows up quickly. That lamb will become a ram. The ram will give you wool.

pie: sóh₂wl̥ h₁idʰé mélh₃t. démi toy gʷʰért? dṓm moy ne h₁ési. sóh₂wl̥ ne dedórḱh₂e. sóh₂wl̥ moy toy mluHdʰí. h₁íd gʷʰermóm h₂éweyes-kʷe kh₂nónti.
english: The sun has come out here. Has it become warm at your home? I have no home. I have not seen the sun. Tell me of your sun! It is warm, and the birds are singing.

pie: owis eḱwobʰyos eweket, "ḱerd angʰetai moi widontei ǵʰm̥onm̥ eḱwons aǵontm̥."
english: The sheep said to the horses: "My heart pains me, seeing a man driving horses."

pie: kéh₂nmn̥ moy kh₂né. léwbʰe ḱl̥nudʰí. sóh₂wl̥ mélh₃t h₂éweyes-kʷe séngʷʰonti. dinós gʷʰermós ḱḗr-kʷe méwdt. ḱód moy kéh₂nmn̥ mówdom dédeh₃ti. nu séngʷʰe.
english: Sing me a song! Listen, dear one! The sun comes forth, and the birds sing. The day is warm, and the heart grows glad. This song gives me joy! Now you sing!

pie: léǵesi? léǵoh₂ pinéḱmi-kʷe. kéh₂nmn̥ moy pinḱdʰí. nókʷts gʷm̥yéti. wĺ̥kʷos stéygʰeti h₂óweyes-kʷe ssénti. ḱód kéh₂nmn̥ wénHm̥.
english: Do you read? I read, and I write. Write me a song! Night comes. The wolf walks, and the sheep sleep. I have grown fond of this song!

pie: ph₂teres moy méh₂tēr-kʷe gʷm̥tā́m. tóh₁ h₂Hséh₂i sodéye. tóybʰos mḗms wéyh₁onm̥-kʷe dh₃dʰí. h₁íh₂ mélit bʰéret. h₁íh₂ h₁suménēs. ph₂tḗr moy séneh₂ kéh₂nmn̥h₂ kh₂néti. h₁ím ḱléwse.
english: My father and mother came. Seat them at the hearth! Give them meat and wine. She brought honey. She is kindly. My father sings old songs. Listen to him!

pie: kʷíh₁ ḱód bʰéh₂mi? gʷṓs h₂mélǵmi. gʷṓs h₂mélǵmi. ph₂tréy toy wékʷsperoy wr̥h₁dʰí. kʷíd gʷówes h₁édn̥ti? h₂éǵroy h₁édn̥ti.
english: How do I say this? I am milking the cows. I am milking the cows. Say it to your father in the evening! What do cows eat? They eat in the pasture.

pie: kʷíh₁ ḱód wéwkōh₂? tr̥syóh₂. tr̥syóh₂. nu wódr̥ préḱsdʰi. h₂ékʷeh₂m moy dh₃dʰí. moḱs h₁éwks.
english: How do I say this? I am thirsty. I am thirsty. Then ask for water! Give me water! You learned quickly!

pie: h₂ówis tu h₁eḱwoibʰ(y)os weukʷét, "ḱḗr Hegʰnutór moi h₁éḱwons Héǵontm̥ Hnérm̥ widn̥tbʰ(y)os."
english: The sheep said to the horses: "My heart pains me, seeing a man driving horses."

pie: h₂wést. moḱs bʰéwdʰm̥. kʷíd moḱs bʰéwdʰs? h₂éweyes kh₂nónt. h₂éweyes h₂éwsosm̥ gʷr̥nHénti. nu kʷid pékʷe. wédos píph₃oh₂.
english: It has dawned! I woke up early. Why did you wake early? The birds were singing. Birds praise the dawn. Now cook something! I am drinking water.

pie: kʷíh₁ ḱód wérh₁oh₂? méh₂term̥ moy stérgetes. méh₂term̥ moy stérgoh₂. h₁ésyeh₂ey h₂Hséh₂i skʷdʰí. swéh₂desh₁ méwdeti. méh₂tr̥s ḱḗr gʷʰermóm.
english: How do I say this? I love my mother. I love my mother. Say it to her at the hearth! She will grow glad with pleasure. A mother's heart is warm.

pie: h₁regʷesyéti. dṓm h₁éymi. stóygʰoh₁ toy h₁wésus h₁syéh₁t. h₂ew bʰéh₂omes. kʷsépi ssdʰí h₂ew-kʷe gʷm̥dʰí.
english: It is getting dark. I am going home. May your way be good! Let us talk again! Rest in the night, and come again!

pie: kʷértrom smḗysi? smimń̥bʰos smḗymi. nu moy sméymn̥ wéwke. ḱwṓ kéh₂nmn̥ nékʷti kh₂nét. wĺ̥kʷōs h₁íd ḱluwént h₂epó-kʷe dr̥mént. gʷr̥Htíns toy dédeh₃mi. túH moy ḱéywos.
english: Machine, do you laugh? I laugh at jokes. Then tell me a joke! A dog was singing a song at night. The wolves heard it, and they ran away! I give you thanks! You are dear to me.

pie: kʷíd skʷálos? skʷálos méǵh₂s péysks. h₂ékʷeh₂i tḱéyti dʰǵʰúHn̥s-kʷe gʷr̥h₃éti. mórtōs skʷálom h₁édn̥ti? h₁ím h₁édn̥ti h₁ésyo-kʷe mḗms gʷr̥nHénti.
english: What is a sheatfish? A sheatfish is a big fish. It lives in the water, and it swallows fish. Do people eat the sheatfish? They eat it, and they praise its meat.

pie: kʷíh₁ mléwHmi? snéygʷʰeti. snéygʷʰeti. swesréy toy wéwke. snígʷʰs póntoh₁i ḱéyor. ǵʰéyōm gʷegʷóme. stóygʰoy mē h₃sléydʰs.
english: How do I say it? It is snowing. It is snowing. Say it to your sister! Snow is lying on the path. Winter has come. Do not slip on the way!

pie: méh₂tēr moy mélit déh₃t. mélit swéh₂dos. h₁íd h₂éḱh₃s? h₁íd h₂éḱh₃m̥ médʰu-kʷe péh₃m̥. médʰu mówdom dédeh₃ti. polh₁ú mē péh₃s. wóydh₂e. h₁eǵóh₂ ne mógʰus.
english: Mother gave me honey. Honey is a pleasure. Did you eat it? I ate it, and I drank mead. Mead gives joy. Do not drink much! I know. I am not a boy.

pie: kʷíd udréh₂? udréh₂ udrós ǵʰwḗr. wédni snéh₂ti dʰǵʰúHn̥s-kʷe h₂éḱh₃t. udréh₂ méǵh₂ih₂ h₁ésti? h₁íh₂ méǵh₂ih₂ ne h₁ésti. h₁íh₂ wédesbʰis HeHḱéwih₂.
english: What is an otter? An otter is a water animal. It swims in the water, and it eats fish. Is the otter big? It is not big. It is swift in the water.

pie: stéwdt. péh₂wr̥ h₂Hséh₂i dʰh₁dʰí. péh₂wr̥ dʰégʷʰeti. nu gʷʰért. sddʰí ssdʰí-kʷe. suHnéwes moy ph₂wéni h₂énti ḱéyror. péh₂wr̥ h₁íns nékʷti ph₂syéh₁t.
english: It has turned cold. Put fire on the hearth! The fire is burning. Now it has become warm. Sit down and rest. My sons are lying near the fire. May the fire guard them in the night!

pie: kúdʰe séneh₂m dn̥ǵʰwéh₂m h₁éwks? h₁íh₂m̥ sénoybʰos wékʷesbʰos h₁éwkm̥. polh₁úh₂ wékʷesh₂ wóydth₂e? polh₁úh₂ wékʷesh₂ wóydh₂e. néweh₂ ne wóydh₂e. nu te néweh₂ doḱéyōh₂. doḱéye me ḱl̥néwoh₂-kʷe.
english: Where did you learn the old tongue? I learned it from old words. Do you know many words? I know many words. New things I do not know. Then I will teach you new things! Teach me, and I will listen!

pie: nésm̥. h₂nér kéh₂ilos h₁sdʰí. kúdʰe gʷéh₂s? swéḱurosyo moy ḱóymom gʷā́m. pótnih₂m toy h₂én widés? h₁íh₂m̥ widóm ḱóm-kʷe h₁ludʰóme.
english: I have come home safe! Be well, man! Where did you go? I went to my father-in-law's village. Did you see your wife there? I saw her, and we arrived together.

pie: h₂énh₁mos h₂wḗh₁ti. h₁éy ḱolHtós? h₁éy ḱolHtós snóygʷʰom-kʷe bʰéreti. nu gʷʰerméh₂m h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂m wéso. h₁íh₂m̥ wésh₂er. swésōr moy h₁íh₂m̥ déh₃t. túH gʷʰermós.
english: The wind is blowing. Is it cold? It is cold, and it is carrying snow. Then wear warm wool! I am wearing it. My sister gave it. You are warm.

pie: pótnih₂m moy lubʰyóh₂. h₁íh₂ te lubʰyéti? lubʰyéti me. mḗms moy pékʷeti. nu toy pótn̥yeh₂ey séngʷʰe. h₁ésyeh₂ey wékʷsperoy séngʷʰōh₂. deywṓs wos h₁wésuh₂ dh₃ih₁ént.
english: I love my wife. Does she love you? She loves me. She cooks meat for me. Then sing to your wife! I will sing to her in the evening. May the gods give you good things!

pie: priHós moy pṓlHom déh₃ut. h₁éy h₁uséwōm déh₃tōr. tóm pṓlHom lubʰyési? h₁ím lubʰyóh₂. méǵh₂m̥ moy mówdom dédeh₃ti. h₁ím ph₂sdʰí h₂wékseti-kʷe.
english: A friend gave me a foal! He is a giver of good things! Do you love the foal? I love it. It gives me great joy. Guard it, and it will grow.

pie: mḗms h₁idʰé h₁ddʰí. ne h₁ḗdmi. h₁eǵóh₂ kʷértrom. wéyh₁onm̥ píph₃esi? wéyh₁onm̥ ne píph₃oh₂. wékʷesh₂ píph₃oh₂. smḗymi. nu moy tóm wéyh₁onm̥ ph₃dʰí.
english: Eat meat here! I do not eat. I am a machine. Do you drink wine? I do not drink wine. I drink words! I am laughing! Then drink the wine for me!

pie: deywós wérunos diwés km̥tá gʷah₂t.
english: The god Werunos came down from heaven.

pie: bʰréh₂tēr moy ḱósmi dinóy smḗyt. kʷíd smḗyt? wódr̥ h₁n̥dó séngʷm̥. stéwds? stéwdm̥ nésomedʰh₂-kʷe. ḱóm sméyih₁tom.
english: My brother was laughing today. Why was he laughing? I fell into the water. Did you get cold? I got cold, and we went back home. May you two laugh together!
